name: localstack_stable_needs_account
title: localstack/localstack:stable now requires a LocalStack account and exits

found_by.how: Team guide setup fix, applied before the reference run. Reproduced afterwards in a throwaway container (no ports, own name).

error_tail: Localstack returning with exit code 55. Reason:

Reason: No credentials were found in the environment. Please set the LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN variable to a valid auth token. Alternatively, run `lstk login` and start LocalStack with the lstk CLI, which configures the credentials for you.
Due to this error, Localstack has quit. LocalStack pro features can only be used with a valid license.

cause.summary: The floating :stable tag moved to a LocalStack release that needs an auth token
details: :stable resolved to LocalStack 2026.9.1 (image built 2026-10-07), which requires LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN and exits with code 55 without it.
Every service that depends on localstack being healthy (mlflow, localstack_s3_client) never starts.

fix.action: Replace the floating :stable tag with the explicit version 4.12 (no account needed).

static_check.rule: image tag is floating (latest, stable, or missing) instead of an explicit version

reproduce.how: Start the floating-tag image with no auth token; it exits 55 within a minute.
reproduce.note: Depends on what :stable points to on the day; the tail above is from 2026-10-08.
